simple.meaning: חוּל (Chûwl) is a Hebrew word meaning “Chul , a son of Aram; also the region settled by him.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חוּל (H2343) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 10:23, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חוּל (H2343) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חוּל (H2343) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חוּל (Chûwl) / H2343 is traced through Genesis 10:23, 1 Chronicles 1:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
